info.name: LEMS SCNMTC Backend
info.description:
LEMS SCNMTC backend API.

1. Import this collection and the 'LEMS local' environment, and select the environment.
2. Start the API (php artisan serve) and create the demo accounts (php artisan db:seed --class=DemoUsersSeeder). Demo accounts are synthetic and local only.
3. Send one request from '1. Sign in as...'. The token is saved automatically.
4. Every request has tests: open the 'Test Results' tab after sending to see green or red.
5. To check everything at once, run ONLY the folder '9. Automated checks' in the Collection Runner (re-run 'php artisan db:seed --class=DemoUsersSeeder' first if you changed demo passwords).

The OpenAPI spec (docs/api/openapi.json) is the source of truth; if this collection disagrees with it, the spec wins.

item.description: A scripted walk through the whole demo flow with an assertion on every step. In Postman: right-click this folder > Run folder (or use the Runner and select only this folder). All steps should be green. It leaves one invited test user behind per run. It does not change any demo password.
